note: Quarterly cash flow from SEC XBRL filings (10-Q, 10-K). 10-Q cash-flow figures are year-to-date, so discrete quarters are derived by differencing (Q2 = H1 - Q1, Q4 = full year - 9 months) unless a 3-month figure is tagged; a restated period shows the most recently filed value. capex = purchases of property and equipment; FCF = operating cash flow - capex; FCF after leases also subtracts principal payments on finance leases. period = calendar quarter of the period end; fiscal = the company's own label. Amazon capex is PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets (purchases of property and equipment before proceeds from sales and incentives, which Amazon nets in its own free-cash-flow figure). Nebius files an annual 20-F and furnishes quarterly results on 6-K without XBRL, so SEC XBRL has no quarterly cash-flow figures for it (annual only). IREN moved from IFRS (20-F/6-K) to US GAAP (10-K/10-Q) in fiscal 2025; only the US GAAP facts are used, so older IFRS quarters are not mixed in. No finance-lease principal payment figure (us-gaap FinanceLeasePrincipalPayments) for the latest quarter of: Oracle; FCF after leases is blank there. Earnings calendar: Alpha Vantage (US listings) and Yahoo Finance (all listings) for every public company in the graph, next 60 days; confirmed = the company's own investor-relations page lists the date, or Alpha Vantage and Yahoo Finance agree and Yahoo does not mark it as an estimate.
